desc:
BISCUIT MIX: Make a delicious meal with this mouth-watering biscuit mix

QUICK AND EASY: Prepare buttermilk biscuits without the mess; just add water, stir and bake for a delicious biscuit in just 15 minutes

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Enjoy biscuits with all your favorite spreads

SIX BISCUITS: Mix makes six tasty biscuits

CONTAINS: 7.5 oz
features:
Features:

Just Add Water: No need for extra ingredients—simply mix with water, drop onto a baking sheet, and bake.

Buttermilk Flavor: Classic tangy buttermilk taste is already included in the mix.

Enriched Flour Base: Contains added nutrients like iron, folic acid, niacin, thiamin, and riboflavin.

Fluffy Texture: Includes leavening agents like baking soda and monocalcium phosphate to create soft, airy biscuits.

Quick Prep Time: Bakes in about 10–12 minutes.

Serves Small Groups: Each pouch makes approximately 6–8 biscuits—perfect for individual use or small families.

Shelf-Stable: Convenient pantry item that doesn’t require refrigeration.

Kosher Dairy Certified.

Clear Allergen Info: Contains wheat and milk; may contain traces of egg and soy.

Benefits:

Super Convenient: Ideal for quick breakfasts, snacks, or side dishes—ready in minutes.

Consistent Results: No measuring or guessing—get reliable, fluffy biscuits every time.

Great Homemade Taste: Buttery and savory, without having to make dough from scratch.

Versatile: Pairs well with soup, gravy, eggs, or can be used in breakfast sandwiches.

Perfect Portion: Small batch size reduces waste and keeps prep fresh.

Nutrient-Fortified: Supports a balanced diet with added vitamins and minerals.
ingredients: enriched flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), palm oil, leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), salt, buttermilk, dextrose.
